families.decision: Organic whole-grain or legume pasta with a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on the pasta pack.
Read ingredients for whole-grain flour or a named bean or lentil flour.
Pick packs naming the farm or mill that supplied the flour.
Skip ingredient lists with colours, flavourings or added sugar.

families.decision: Organic whole leaves, seeds or beans with the grower and origin named.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on a sealed pack.
Read the ingredient line for each named plant in a blend.
Pick labels naming a farm, grower cooperative or family producer.
Skip packs listing added flavourings or showing damp, clumped contents.

families.decision: Organic sprouted whole-grain sourdough with a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and sprouted whole-grain wording.
Read ingredients for sprouted whole grains or whole sprouted flour.
Check for sourdough starter and whole-grain flour in the starter.
Pick packs naming a small bakery; skip added gluten and dough conditioners.

families.decision: Organic whole grains with the grain and farm named on the pack.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and whole-grain wording.
Read the ingredient line for a single named grain.
Pick sealed packs naming the grower and growing region.
Skip mixes listing added flavourings or sweeteners.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain, nut or root flour from a named mill.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and the grain, nut or root named.
Read grain-flour labels for whole grain or 100% extraction.
Check the milling date and pick sealed packs from a named small mill.
Skip blends led by isolated starch or listing added flavourings.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted baking from a named small bakery.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and whole-grain wording for every flour.
Read for sourdough starter or sprouted grains in the ingredient line.
Check sourdough labels for fermentation details, without added baker's yeast.
Pick packs naming a small bakery; skip added gluten and dough conditioners.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted baking with butter and a short recipe.
buying_tips: Look for organic whole-grain flour and sprouted or sourdough wording.
Read the ingredient line for butter or coconut oil.
Pick a named small bakery using honey, maple syrup or fruit to sweeten.
Skip ingredient lists with margarine, shortening or artificial flavourings.

families.decision: Organic unsweetened muesli with sprouted whole grains and a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and sprouted grains on the label.
Read ingredients for whole grains, nuts, seeds and optional dried fruit.
Check the growing origin and prefer packs naming a farm or small producer.
Skip ingredient lists with syrup, added sugar, flavourings or puffed cereals.

families.decision: Organic live ferments, labelled unpasteurised and sold refrigerated.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and fermented wording on the jar or bottle.
Check for live cultures and raw or unpasteurised wording.
Read keep refrigerated instructions and choose from the cold case.
Pick glass jars or bottles naming a local maker and ingredient origins.

families.decision: Organic raw, unfiltered vinegar with its fruit source named.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and raw or unpasteurised wording.
Read the ingredient line for the named fruit or fermented base.
Pick glass bottles naming the orchard, farm or small vinegar maker.
Skip bottles listing caramel colour, flavourings or added sweeteners.

families.decision: Plain organic fermented soy with named cultures and a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and fermented wording.
Read ingredients for whole soybeans, cultures and every added grain.
Pick packs naming a small maker and the beans' growing origin.
Check storage instructions and read any separate sauce packet's ingredients.

pasta_dry.decision: Organic whole-durum pasta with just flour and water, from a named farm.
pasta_dry.delta: Bronze-cut wording describes a porous surface; look for slow drying at low temperature.

coffee_beans.decision: Organic whole-bean coffee from a named small roaster.
coffee_beans.delta: Look for a roast date on the bag; Arabica is the bean species.

sprouted_grain_bread.decision: Organic sprouted whole-grain sourdough with just grains, water, starter and salt.
sprouted_grain_bread.delta: Sprouted wheat, rye, barley and spelt still contain gluten.

sprouted_grains.decision: Organic dried sprouted whole grains from a named grower.
sprouted_grains.delta: Sprouted must describe the kernels; read the pack's cooking instructions.

specialty_flours.decision: Organic freshly milled sprouted whole-grain flour from a named small mill.
specialty_flours.delta: Einkorn and spelt are wheat; stoneground flour can still be sifted.

gluten_free_bread.decision: Organic gluten-free whole-grain sourdough with a short ingredient list.
gluten_free_bread.delta: Look for gluten-free wording; brown rice, buckwheat, millet or teff should lead the flours.

buns_rolls.decision: Organic whole-wheat sourdough buns or rolls from a named small bakery.
buns_rolls.delta: Milk, eggs and butter can be bun ingredients; whole white wheat is still whole grain.

pastries_muffins.decision: Organic sprouted whole-grain muffins or sourdough pastries made with butter.
pastries_muffins.delta: Read filling and icing ingredients too; choose an unfilled pastry or plain muffin.

muesli.decision: Organic unsweetened muesli with sprouted oat flakes, buckwheat and seeds.
muesli.delta: Oat flakes and buckwheat base; check cooking directions on the pack.

bread_aisle.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted bread from a named small bakery.
bread_aisle.delta: Frozen loaves qualify; check keep-frozen or freeze-upon-arrival wording.

kombucha.decision: Organic plain raw kombucha in glass, labelled live and sold refrigerated.
kombucha.delta: Black tea, sugar and culture make the base; read the bottle's alcohol declaration.

sauerkraut.decision: Organic raw sauerkraut of cabbage and salt, in a refrigerated glass jar.
sauerkraut.delta: Cabbage and salt are enough; red or green cabbage can be used.

kimchi.decision: Organic unpasteurised kimchi fermented with salt, in a refrigerated glass jar.
kimchi.delta: Napa cabbage or radish base; read fish sauce or shrimp ingredients when included.

fermented_pickles.decision: Organic live cucumber pickles fermented in salt brine, sold refrigerated.
fermented_pickles.delta: Cucumbers, water, salt and spices; skip vinegar in the ingredient line.

raw_cider_vinegar.decision: Organic raw unfiltered apple cider vinegar with the mother, from a named orchard.
raw_cider_vinegar.delta: Look for with the mother wording and apple variety or harvest details.

miso.decision: Organic naturally aged, unpasteurised miso with soybeans, koji and salt.
miso.delta: Read the named koji grain and aging time; Hatcho can contain barley flour.

tempeh.decision: Organic plain unpasteurised tempeh, with soybeans and culture, sold chilled or frozen.
tempeh.delta: Rhizopus culture binds the bean cake; follow the pack's cooking directions.

natto.decision: Organic plain whole-bean natto with live culture, sold chilled or frozen.
natto.delta: Look for Bacillus subtilis culture; plain beans can be sold without sauce packets.

groups.title: Live fermented cabbage and cucumber pickles
groups.why_same: All use the same organic, live, unpasteurised and refrigerated label checks, with vegetables fermented in salt rather than added vinegar.

groups.title: Whole-grain loaves, buns and rolls
groups.why_same: Both use the same organic, whole-grain, starter or sprouted-ingredient checks and preference for a named small bakery.
